description: Create a Father's Day wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_item. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id. OpenAPI: createWishlist.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED — curated ASINs only produce /dp links on amazon.se; other marketplaces get search deep-links. Links omit ?tag= until Marcus registers real Associates IDs.

name: create_wishlist
title: Create dad gift wishlist
